question_text: Outline how a Python class can use encapsulation to protect an account balance from invalid updates. Do not assume a leading underscore enforces privacy.
adaptation_rationale: Accurate Python encapsulation, avoiding the claim that name conventions enforce strict privacy. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Keep balance state and balance-changing methods together, and provide a controlled deposit/withdraw interface that checks amounts rather than expecting callers to edit state directly. An underscore signals internal use by convention, not a security barrier.

marking_points.criterion: Bundles balance state with related methods.
Controlled method interface validates changes/reduces direct mutation; no false enforced-privacy claim.
